decisions.reason: After several years the option value of waiting is low, and a guided tour still ties up staff and depends on volatile visitor demand, so we would release resources unless it has clearly become a dependable traffic driver.
This sweet pastry fits the firm's core confectionery skills and can usually be carried at low incremental cost, so if it remains in the assortment by 2022 it is likely worth retaining.

A crusty farmhouse bread is close to the bakery's established offer and sourcing base, and although breads can be rationalized if overlap is high, the cost of keeping a proven core-style loaf is modest.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen has an award signal and was presented as a flagship product, which strongly supports continued commitment in a seasonal category central to the firm's identity.

The premium Christmas stollen is also award-winning and close to the firm's seasonal strengths, but it carries somewhat more exit risk than the flagship variant because overlapping festive lines can be consolidated.
